tasks.short: Identify and report store safety concerns

steps.what: Identify safety concerns in the shopping and working environment
Report verified safety concerns to the responsible personnel

tasks.design: Configure a {WORKFLOW} safety form and responsibility directory to prepare a concise report and suggest the appropriate recipient. The specialist verifies the concern and recipient before sending, and urgent hazards still use immediate direct escalation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reporting repeats location, concern and recipient details after observation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native forms and recipient rules can reduce repeated message assembly without classifying safety risk automatically.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising urgency and ensuring the right person acts.
tasks.human_edge: Judge actual conditions and communicate immediate risks clearly.
tasks.altitude: Slightly less report assembly, with unchanged inspection and escalation responsibilities.

evidence.claim: Native safety forms and explicit recipient rules are plausible model knowledge; the digest supplies no measured retail safety-reporting saving.

assumptions: Boundary is specialist observation and reporting, excluding manager remediation. Immediate hazard response is unchanged and cannot wait for form completion.

Specialist produces location, observation time, factual concern, urgency judgement and immediate action in s1, with capture and clarification retained in its full 75 hours. A manager owns the responsibility directory; additional upkeep is counted.
Test native forms first. Missing recipient or uncertain urgency returns to direct human reporting, not inferred escalation.
Two focal hours and one manager hour cover additional routing and template corrections. No new recipient-response burden is treated as a saving.
research_questions: Does form-based assembly save time after capture and recipient checks without delaying urgent action?

already_counted.description: Report accuracy, recipient check and sending

incremental.description: Safety form and routing exception upkeep

approvals.approved_version: Exact concern, location, time, urgency, immediate actions and recipient; edits require renewed send approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=75+20=95, gross=5, upkeep=2, net=3. High assumes 20% less reporting effort through reusable forms; low retains manual reporting for urgent or ambiguous situations plus upkeep. Physical identification and response judgement retain all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Conduct store audits using direct checks and available records
Identify problem areas and procedural deficiencies from audit evidence

tasks.design: Retain direct store audit checks and contextual finding assessment. Existing {DOCS} checklists support the audit; the task does not establish a duplicate reporting baseline or machine-ready evidence feed.
tasks.previous_blocker: A procedural deficiency requires evidence and understanding of store operations.
tasks.enabler_now: No documented retail audit labour saving is supplied in the digest.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguishing isolated exceptions from deficient controls.
tasks.human_edge: Ask follow-up questions and assess whether the evidence supports the finding.
tasks.altitude: Audit scope and judgement remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Connect audit findings to practical corrective action

evidence.claim: Store audit observation and interpretation remain human work; no relevant measured replacement is documented.

assumptions: Boundary is specialist store audit and findings, excluding manager remediation. Routine compliance observation and audit sampling overlap must be assigned once in roll-ups.
Specialist produces audit observations in s1 with capture fully retained. No structured discrepancy codes or automated findings are assumed.
Check native audit checklists first. Unchanged audit process adds no upkeep.
research_questions: Which audit actions are physical checks and which are genuinely repeated data handling?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=65+35=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Direct audit checks and finding judgement retain all time; no invented reporting share.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Monitor compliance with loss prevention, physical security and risk management procedures

tasks.design: Keep observation and contextual interpretation of procedure compliance human. Existing {DOCS} procedures remain references, with no automatic employee scoring or claim that routine records establish actual adherence.
tasks.previous_blocker: Observed behaviour and local circumstances must be understood together.
tasks.enabler_now: No relevant validated replacement for this monitoring task appears in the digest.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising incomplete controls without misinterpreting justified actions.
tasks.human_edge: Observe fairly and seek explanations before concluding non-compliance.
tasks.altitude: Monitoring responsibility and time remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Distinguish evidence from inference about employees

evidence.claim: Human compliance observation is retained; the digest does not establish a general procedure-compliance automation saving.

assumptions: Boundary is specialist ongoing compliance observation, excluding disciplinary decisions and remediation. Observations reused in audits are allocated once.
Specialist produces contextual observations during the fully counted step; no structured employee adherence feed is assumed.
Use native procedure access first. Unchanged monitoring creates zero incremental upkeep.
unknowns: Local staff consultation and access rules
research_questions: Which observations need direct clarification before a compliance concern is raised?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Observational judgement retains all time and employee work is excluded from the denominator.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Perform covert surveillance of authorised areas susceptible to merchandise loss

tasks.design: Retain bounded human observation within the existing authorised purpose and area. Existing {DOCS} authorisation records define scope; the design adds no camera analytics or automated inference of theft.
tasks.previous_blocker: Events need contextual observation and may not show intent.
tasks.enabler_now: Shop gesture alerts exist, but the digest does not establish that they replace covert dock or warehouse surveillance effort.
tasks.still_hard: Incomplete visibility, ambiguous actions and proportionate follow-up.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguish observed facts from suspicion and remain within the authorised scope.
tasks.altitude: Surveillance scope, attention time and investigative authority remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Document purpose, limits and escalation requirements

evidence.claim: Veesion flags suspicious shop-camera gestures for staff judgement; this is not evidence of reduced covert dock or warehouse surveillance time.
Retaining direct surveillance without a new analytical system earns no labour saving.

assumptions: Boundary is specialist observation under an existing authorised assignment, excluding authorisation decisions, equipment installation and later investigation.
Supervisor or authorised manager produces purpose, area, duration and permitted methods under the unchanged assignment process; no new structured surveillance feed is consumed or claimed free.
Native assignment records are preferred. National rules, staff consultation and data access must be checked locally; this design introduces no new surveillance method or upkeep.
unknowns: Applicable local privacy and employment requirements
research_questions: What observed evidence is sufficient for proportionate human follow-up without inferring intent?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Human observation retains full attention; a retail gesture-alert product does not establish equivalent coverage or a surveillance labour saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: A small safety-report assembly gain is possible; direct audits, compliance observation and authorised surveillance remain human work.
reach: Agree safety-response routes and observation boundaries with security supervisors
skills_to_grow: Separating observed events from inferred intent
role.ambitious_version: A loss prevention specialist with clearer safety reports who retains direct observation, fair interpretation and proportionate escalation.
